headline: One import cycle of 229 files in src/server makes 181 of 268 route handlers, 559 of 562 pages and the proxy each load about 10 MB of server code: a fat route takes 0.9 to 1.3 s and 97 MB of heap to load cold on this machine against 0.16 to 0.24 s and 26 MB for /api/health, and every instance first pays 0.27 to 0.30 s for a start hook and about 0.09 s to read a 10.4 MB list of server references. None of it depends on what a store uses, so it grows with stores, traffic and the deploy on every push once the platform opens. The cure is a few dozen small import changes, not removed features (all simulated on the build's own module graph): the visit beacon 10.4 -> 1.9 MB with one import path, a storefront page 11.3 -> about 3.5 MB, the proxy 9.2 -> 2.4 MB (0.8 MB with its readers split), and 2.2 MB off 384 admin pages. Three things the report missed are added (a three-line key reader that brings the Stripe SDK to storefront pages, the theme store's server code in every store's page renderer, and the manifest read at every cold start), and a scan test plus a byte budget must land with the cuts or the next convenient import undoes them.

findings.title: The visit beacon and 52 other routes import the chat agent to get a ten-line function
findings.saving: /api/visit 10.4 -> 1.9 MB (2,015 -> 708 modules); about 0.7 s of its cold load here; ten handlers leave the fat group

findings.title: One import cycle of 229 server files makes almost every route load everything
findings.saving: Storefront home 11.3 -> 7.7 MB with three edits; fat handlers 181 -> 29 with all cuts; cold page about 1.1 -> 0.6-0.7 s (est.)

findings.title: schema.ts (19,614 lines) is evaluated in every function and used by none at run time
findings.saving: About 0.7 MB and 55 to 70 ms per cold start on every database route; /api/health 1,125 -> 395 KB

findings.title: Every instance start loads 856 modules and queries the database before the first request
findings.saving: 856 -> 208 modules at every instance start; est. 0.2 to 0.25 s and 25 to 35 MB of heap per cold start of every function

findings.title: The admin's whole interface text, both languages, loads wherever one word is needed
findings.saving: Step a: storefront home 7.7 -> 5.0 MB, proxy 5.2 -> 2.4 MB; step b: at most 2.2 MB off an admin page

findings.title: Nothing measures or limits the server graph, so it only grows
findings.saving: None by itself; keeps about 8.5 MB on the beacon, 7.5 MB on a storefront page and 8 MB on the proxy from coming back

findings.title: The admin shell loads the AI manager's whole engine on every admin page
findings.saving: Admin orders 11.0 -> 8.8 MB, 2,425 -> 2,030 modules; admin pages reaching the AI tools 384 -> about 60; est. 0.15-0.2 s

findings.title: Eighteen modules import the payment settings file for a three-line key reader, and the Stripe SDK comes with it
findings.saving: Stripe SDK off 26 of 59 storefront pages and 60 handlers: 205 modules and 260 KB each (after SG-1)

findings.title: The page renderer imports the theme store's server code for every page of every store
findings.saving: 67 modules and 464 KB off 96 routes; sharp no longer loaded by 56 of 58 storefront pages (after SG-1)

findings.title: The proxy that runs before every store page loads the whole graph
findings.saving: Proxy 9.2 -> 2.4 MB from the P0 cuts alone, -> 0.8 MB with its readers split; cold load about 0.9 -> 0.2-0.25 s (est.)

findings.title: The sharp image library is loaded at cold start by routes that never touch a picture
findings.saving: About 50 ms and 28 MB of RSS per cold instance of routes that reach sharp; package size unchanged

findings.title: Every cold function reads a 10.4 MB list of server references before its first request
findings.saving: 10-12 ms and 3 MB per cold start from planned cuts (14% fewer entries); about 70 ms and 20 MB stay; a budget stops growth

findings.title: The AI manager's tool catalogue is converted to JSON Schema at import, on routes with no AI
findings.saving: About 42 ms per cold start of a route that loads the tool catalogue without using it

findings.title: The build writes the same server chunks many times: 124 MiB of 196 MiB is repeats
findings.saving: Est. 80-100 MiB of chunk JS and about 300 MiB of maps off the build output once the blob is cut; memory gain untested

findings.title: Reader and writer share a file, so a new import between features re-joins reads to writes
findings.saving: Not megabytes (32 KB on a storefront page); the rule keeps the gains of SG-1 and SG-2

findings.title: The 13 MB taxonomy is traced into every function, including those that cannot read it
findings.saving: 12.7 MiB of package for about 90 functions; nothing at run time

findings.title: getStore() imports the Stripe SDK to learn which payment modes have keys
findings.saving: /api/visit 1,173 -> 956 KB and 198 fewer modules; handlers reaching the SDK 155 -> 95 with SG-18

findings.title: Four storefront languages are imported for every server route; a request needs one
findings.saving: About 290 KB and 10 ms per cold start
